name: servirtium
description: Record/replay for HTTP service tests in the Servirtium markdown tape format — a thin D binding over the shared pure-Aether VCR engine.
comment-native: The engine .so ships in native/ next to the package; lflags point the linker and the runtime loader there via an $ORIGIN-relative rpath, so a consumer needs no LD_LIBRARY_PATH and no SERVIRTIUM_VCR_LIB.
